contexts.text: The Nicene Creed quoted. See Ath 133. Ath 134. CanonsNC 43. Trinity. 5. 2. Inv 30.

Trinity. 3. 6. A Trinity of Persons in the Divinity from eternity was first invented by the Nicene Council, as is evident from the two Creeds, the Nicene and the Athanasian... Explained. CanonsNC 41. Trinity. 7. 5.
